what_would_decide_it.sufficiency_note: The NANOGrav/IPTA table would be sufficient ALONE only if published with its covariance; a figure-only release (points with error bars, no covariance) is usable for a rough diagonal-only chi2 but not for a defensible 68/95% interval on c4_pta_product.
